notes: release 9.3: the playhead and the audio you hear are now time-aligned. On startup BriVoice plays a near-silent two-second probe, reads the AudioTrack timestamps to measure this device's output latency (31-33 ms on the test emulator), and stores it; during playback the current track's live timestamp is read and smoothed, and the playhead is offset by that latency. If a device cannot report timestamps, a one-time walkthrough points to the manual compensation slider. Auto-measurement can be turned off and re-run from Settings; audio, voices and exports are unchanged
